svg.title: coderprint: 703k lines of code in use, of 1.4M written, all time
svg.desc: 702,849 lines of code in use (470,842 in production, 232,007 in tests), of 1,380,145 written (all time, charted since 06MAR2026): 3,517 commits across all branches, 66 active days, a longest streak of 40 days, a current streak of 11 days, and 5 languages at 1% or more of the lines of code. They came in 3 bursts of 19k, 56k and 1.3M lines of code. The bars end on 28OCT2026, the day this panel was drawn. Share of lines of code by language: Rust 59%, Lean 19%, Python 12%, TypeScript 6%, JavaScript 3%, other languages under 1%. Of what was written, 51% is kept.
